stepTitle: blank (i): Fill in the blank to add $$\text{has\_feat}$$ to $$\text{song\_sample}.$$
stepBody:
Milad adds two columns: $$	ext{has\_feat}$$ and $$	ext{num\_feats}$$ to $$	ext{song\_sample}.$$

(i) Fill in the blank in the box below to add the column $$	ext{has\_feat}$$ to $$	ext{song\_sample}.$$ A row has a value of $$1$$ in $$	ext{has\_feat}$$ if the artist has the substring "feat." and $$0$$ otherwise.

$$	ext{song\_sample}["	ext{has\_feat}"]$$ $$=$$ [blank]##figure1.gif##
